english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when saying that two things are connected or associated.

exampleSentences.english: This report is related to the matter.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 pin1 bou3 dou6 tung4 gin6 si6 jau5 gwaan1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something related or pertinent to a topic.

exampleSentences.english: This information is relevant to your report.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢啲資料同你份報告有關。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 zi1 liu6 tung4 nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 gwaan1

english.note: Use this for people or things involved in, affected by, or relevant to a particular matter, especially before a noun.

exampleSentences.english: All concerned parties have to attend the hearing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 所有有關人士都要出席聽證會。
exampleSentences.jyutping: so2 jau5 jau5 gwaan1 jan4 si6 dou1 jiu3 ceot1 zik6 teng1 zing3 wui2
